items.docs: Fetch detailed project information. Accepts all standard API key types. Callable via ReadMe MCP execute-request when this route is enabled in ReadMe MCP route toggles.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of the impact which can by purchased by the project category.

items.docs: List impact project categories. Accepts all standard API key types. Callable via ReadMe MCP execute-request when this route is enabled in ReadMe MCP route toggles.

params.name: country
params.description: Defines a country where the project is located.

params.name: projectCategoryId
params.description: Defines the category that the project falls under. It links the project to its relevant category.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of the impact which can by purchased by the project category.

params.name: vintage
params.description: The year when the project started.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency in which the project prices are returned. Returns in the account's currency for an authenticated call, otherwise in USD if it's not provided.

params.name: lng
params.description: The locale what the project is returned in.

params.name: plan
params.description: The subscription plan to fetch the project prices for.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Comma separated list of the project statuses. Default to approved.

items.docs: List impact projects available to the account. Accepts all standard API key types. Callable via ReadMe MCP execute-request when this route is enabled in ReadMe MCP route toggles.
